reply.content:
**FY2022 retention ratio: 54.03%.**

Calculation: \((\$2,707.3\text{ million net earnings attributable to General Mills} - \$1,244.5\text{ million cash dividends paid}) \div \$2,707.3\text{ million} = 54.03\%\). Net earnings are reported on page 45; dividends paid are reported on page 49.

I need to calculate the retention ratio using the formula: (net income attributable to shareholders - cash dividends paid) / net income attributable to shareholders. For General Mills, the net income is 2707.3, and cash dividends are 1244.5. So, the calculation goes: 2707.3 - 1244.5 = 1462.8, then divide this by 2707.3, which gives approximately 54.03%.
